paper_title: The Devil Is in Gradient Entanglement: Energy-Aware Gradient Coordinator for Robust Generalized Category Discovery
venue: CVPR2026 pp3563-3573; official CVF independently verified via search and existing proxy after browser403
official_binding: Author paper and official CVF link haiyangzheng.github.io/EAGC whose Code link binds repository; exact paper experiment/checkpoint release not established
license: Complete untruncated pinned tree has no root LICENSE/COPYING. Apache2.0 Facebook backbone header read, not a permission grant for entire project. No source copied, installed or executed.
paper_read_scope: Intro/preliminaries, method4.1-4.3 and Algorithm1, experiment5.1-5.6/conclusion6, appendixB.1-B.4/C.1-C.5/D and qualitative textE; not all statistical tableA, figures visually, other baseline implementations or diagnosis driver.
original_task: Offline generalized category discovery on mixed labeled Known and unlabeled Known/Novel image sets, not causal persistent video categories.
model_inputs: Two stochastic 224px image views. Labeled Known mask/labels offline only; unlabelled labels retained by dataset but excluded from inspected supervised losses. No text or vocabulary passed to inspected backbone/head.
model_outputs: 768D backbone features, three-layer 256D contrast projection plus normalized-feature weighted linear Known+Novel classifier. Main training wraps a separate one-layer 768D ReLU MLP before this DINOHead.
losses: Masked Known CE/temperature0.1 and SupCon, two-view self-distillation with detached same-step logits and batch entropy regularization, instance InfoNCE. Sup weight0.35. AGA/EEP modify output-feature gradients through hooks, not the printed scalar loss.
gradient_mechanism: Frozen labeled-only reference, fixed uncentered Conceptor R(R+aperture^-2 I)^-1 from reference Known Train features. Gradient first g - weight*(g@C) for unlabeled rows then labeled AGA correction weight/(N_labeled_views*D)*(features-reference), with AMP scaler scale applied. Projector parameter gradients themselves are not directly projected.
training_protocol: Inspected CUB shell: DINO ViT-B/16, only block11 trainable, SGD/cosine200epochs/batch128/backbone0.1/head1.0; reference30epochs/batch32/lr0.02; AGA0.7/aperture2/EEP0.5. Sampler balances labeled/unlabeled. No code executed or training resources consumed.
online_or_offline: Offline joint dataset training and repeated full-unlabelled-Train evaluation. Test forward image-only backbone/projector argmax; no continual inference updates or category bank.
state_memory: Frozen reference/backbone conceptor and scalar labeled-energy EMA0.95 are training state, not persistent anonymous-category tokens. No candidate-aware WAIT, tentative/confirmed/quarantine, reversible split/merge or versioned cross-video events.
evaluation: Predictions and labels collected separately then Hungarian matching over all categories, including Known. Best epoch chosen by All accuracy of actual unlabelled Train labels; default GT total class count sets classifier cardinality. Neither is transferable to our fixed-Known sealed-label protocol.
static_findings_not_executed_failures: Main SimGCD.py662-667 uses known+novel split lengths for out_dim unless --estk/--ested_k; latter is a supplied value, not an estimator implemented on that active path.

SimGCD.py477-516 selects/save_best by unlabelled Train GT All ACC, despite no unlabelled GT in inspected direct supervised training losses. This is a model-selection boundary, not a demonstrated online label leak.

Reference requires_grad false and no_grad true; train() calls reference.train(). Default inspected DINO build has drop/drop_path0 and LayerNorm, so train() alone is not evidence of stochastic-anchor drift on that path. DINOv2 body not reviewed.
DINOHead classification normalizes its input, not 256D contrast projection; main additional MLP supplies ReLU-transformed768D input. Do not assume vanilla DINOHead bottleneck classifier.
AGA actual mean-normalized correction and clamped adaptive EEP with labeled energy EMA require explicit convention if borrowing; do not substitute unscaled paper symbols.
Parser eval_funcs defaults v2,v2p but inspected EVAL_FUNCS has only v2,v2b. CUB script explicitly v2, so default mismatch is not an executed CUB-script failure.
requirements.txt contains machine-local file:// references and mixed CUDA package generations. No wholesale installation, dependency/environment compatibility claim or dataset/split pickle decoding.
First epoch initializes best stats but does not save; only strict later improvement reaches save_best. Checkpoint existence was not tested.
Retained unlabelled targets and official GT K are part of upstream benchmark setup; neither imported into TrackOCD forward/protocol.
paper_limitations_summary: Reference/subspace quality, added training overhead and limited standard-GCD coverage; dynamic/domain-shift generalization remains unproven.
TrackOCD_root_connection: Our selected-checkpoint CE/risk cosine antagonism and Raw-versus-adapter geometry loss justify a bounded representation hypothesis, but are not their supervised/unsupervised GDC/SOC measurement, historical optimizer evidence or a confirmed training cause.
what_to_borrow: Lawful independent Train reference and geometry-preserving controls; measure actual optimizer gradients, neighborhood/rank/Known/Novel tradeoff against Raw. Candidate hypothesis only after full source review and fresh folds.
what_not_to_borrow: Unlabelled/final GT checkpoint selection, oracle Novel count, known-remapping accuracy as fixedKnown/CT, image-pair identity contrast as category positives, offline training hooks as online persistence.
requires_before_qualified_import: Independent lawful folds/selection and causal policy-memory contract
